subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our upcoming team-building event scheduled for next Friday at the local park. This event is a great opportunity for us to relax, bond, and have some fun outside of the office environment. Please mark your calendars and RSVP by the end of this week so we can make the necessary arrangements. We look forward to seeing all of you there! Best regards, [Your Name] HR Coordinator
